    // The velocity solve: warm start, then `VelocityIterations` sweeps. More
    // sweeps means a stiffer, less springy stack; the cost is exactly linear in the
    // count, which is why the number lives in `TimeStepSettings` where a caller can
    // trade it.
    SolveVelocities(world: RigidWorld3D): RigidWorld3D
        => Indices(world.TimeStep.VelocityIterations)
            .Reduce(WarmStart(world), (acc, i) => SolveVelocityPass(acc));
